summary: The v0.3 script’s core linear algebra is internally consistent for the stated qubit amp-damping toy model: the state preparation, Bell projection, trace-out, and partial-transpose log-negativity all check out, and the Bell-state limit at high transmittance behaves as expected. The audit fails because the work is being over-interpreted: the repo promotes a single-outcome toy quantity as the definitive β bound, the dense sweep/CSV/plot use a different Bell-outcome aggregation than the prose, the qubit loss model is mislabeled as a physical pure-loss/linear-optic BSM surrogate despite incompatible success-probability scaling, and the docs silently upgrade an exploratory [CONJ]-level numerical signal into a “real value / fast-track β” decision claim while the derivation note still says the β-vs-Pirandola comparison is agnostic pending unresolved reductions.

issues.description: The headline `0.094× Pirandola` claim is computed from only the `Psi-` branch (`p_{Psi-} * LN_{Psi-}`), but the same model gives an identical `Psi+` branch, and the dense sweep/CSV/plot aggregate Bell outcomes and produce a low-η ratio near `0.19×`, not `0.094×`. For a flagged effective channel, or for a linear-optic BSM that announces both `Psi±` outcomes, dropping `Psi+` is not an apples-to-apples comparison to Pirandola’s per-use bound.
issues.suggestion: Choose and justify one comparison object: `Psi-`-only postselected toy metric, `Psi±` flagged linear-optic BSM, or an ideal 4-outcome Bell measurement. Regenerate the docs/data/plot so every artifact uses the same definition, and label the other aggregations as sensitivity checks rather than the main result.

issues.description: The documentation silently upgrades a scoped exploratory result into a definitive β-path conclusion. The finding doc starts with 'directional signal only' and 'no rigor upgrade', but later calls v0.3 the '最终 definitive result', 'β 真实值', and recommends fast-tracking β; the MQ snapshot says it is only a [SYN] aggregator that introduces no new rigor, yet §11.0.2 repeats the definitive claim. This directly contradicts the derivation note, which still says the β-vs-Pirandola direction is agnostic pending SDP / reduction work.
issues.suggestion: Demote the v0.3 and MQ conclusions back to exploratory [CONJ]-level status, explicitly tie any comparison to unresolved β.G3/β.G5 assumptions, and remove the 'β real value / fast-track β' language until a validated comparison object and reduction argument exist.

issues.description: The v0.3 numerics are being described as 'physical' / 'qubit pure-loss truth', but the implemented model is not a faithful linear-optic pure-loss BSM surrogate. In the symmetric case the code yields `p_{Psi-} = eta(2-eta)/4` (for example `0.0475` at `eta=0.1`), which is linear at low `eta` because loss is identified with logical `|0>`. Physical HOM/MDI Bell-measurement success depends on both arms surviving and does not have this scaling. The matrix calculation is fine for the toy model, but the physical interpretation is overstated.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite v0.3 as a toy single-rail/qubit exploration, add an explicit caveat that its Bell-success probabilities do not reproduce bosonic MDI physics, and avoid using it as the numeric proxy for the bosonic β bound until the measurement model includes the correct success/failure structure.

issues.description: The integrated β.G3 finding is not clean after the v0.1/v0.2/v0.3 appendings. Section numbering restarts mid-file, the Werner heuristic is described as a 'β lower bound' even though it is only a heuristic surrogate, the prose never explains the `0.094×` vs `0.19×` discrepancy between the single-branch claim and the sweep/plot/CSV, and the MQ snapshot copies only the stronger interpretation. That makes the audit trail hard to trust.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite the finding as separate v0.1/v0.2/v0.3 subsections with one canonical comparison table, explicitly explain `Psi-` vs `Psi±` vs 4-Bell aggregation, and keep the Werner result labeled as heuristic-only rather than lower/upper-bound language.

round_recommendation: Reset the claim surface first: pick one Bell-outcome aggregation convention, rewrite v0.3 and MQ §11.0.2 as exploratory toy-model evidence with explicit measurement-model caveats, and only then reassess whether the numerics support fast-tracking β.
